headline: Apollo 17 takes the Blue Marble
post_facts: Last crewed mission to the Moon

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen seventy-two... astronauts took one of the most famous photos ever made.

scenes.label: Kennedy Space Center
scenes.caption: Apollo 17 lifts off at night
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Apollo seventeen had launched just hours earlier, bound for the Moon.

scenes.label: from Earth when the photo was taken
scenes.text: [softly] About eighteen thousand miles out, the crew looked back... and saw the whole Earth, fully lit by the Sun.

scenes.label: The Blue Marble
scenes.caption: Earth seen from Apollo 17
scenes.text: [warmly] The photo became known... as the Blue Marble.

scenes.title: The last trip to the Moon
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] It was the last time humans traveled to the Moon.

scenes.title: Have you seen this photo before?
scenes.text: [gently] Have you seen this photo before?
